source.note: AMU Department of Computer Science, BCA = B.Sc. (Hons.) Computer Applications, batch 2021-24, CBCS curriculum (2017). Shared by Mohd Rameez Khan. Courses live under Faculty-of-Science/BCA/Sem<N>/ (electives under Faculty-of-Science/BCA/Electives/); use find_courses. Computer Applications courses are CCB-xxx; the other two subjects are Mathematics (MMB-xxx: Calculus, 2D/3D Coordinate Geometry, Numerical Analysis, ODE, Advanced Calculus, PDE, Linear Algebra) and Statistics (STB-xxx: Descriptive Statistics, Probability, Sampling Distributions, Survey Sampling, with lab courses STBnP1). 'Practical Lab - N' = CCBnP1 (Sem 5 = CCB5P2). Sem 5 electives taken: Computer System Architecture CCB554, Programming Using Java CCB564, Organizational Behaviour CCB574; Sem 6 elective Data Mining CCB663. 'Senior Project - I' = CCB582, 'Senior Project - II' = CCB6S4, 'Seminar Presentation' = CCB6S3. 'Exams/…/End Semester' and 'Sessional' are question papers. Foundation courses (Sunni Theology, Urdu Course B, Environmental Science, Geography, English) are not in the catalog yet: review them with the course code if the paper shows one. 'Books' folders hold published books: not ours to publish. Lab work is students' own programs (keep as code files in Records).
